examples.en: The principal gave a solemn speech at the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 校長在畢業典禮上發表了莊嚴的演說。

examples.en: He made a solemn promise to take care of his younger sister.
examples.zh: 他鄭重承諾會照顧妹妹。

examples.en: Everyone fell silent during the solemn ceremony.
examples.zh: 在這場莊嚴的儀式中，每個人都安靜下來。

examples.en: The students showed solidarity by working on the project together.
examples.zh: 學生們一起完成專題，展現了團結的精神。

examples.en: Workers across the country expressed solidarity with the strikers.
examples.zh: 全國各地的勞工表達了對罷工者的聲援。

examples.en: Our neighbors showed great solidarity after the flood.
examples.zh: 水災過後，我們的鄰居展現了高度的團結。

examples.en: He enjoys long solitary walks along the river.
examples.zh: 他喜歡沿著河邊獨自長時間散步。

examples.en: A solitary tree stood on the top of the hill.
examples.zh: 一棵孤零零的樹立在山頂上。

examples.en: The old man lived a solitary life in the mountains.
examples.zh: 那位老先生在山裡過著獨居生活。

examples.en: She likes to enjoy solitude in her room after a busy day.
examples.zh: 她喜歡在忙碌的一天後待在房間裡獨處。

examples.en: The writer went to a cabin to find solitude.
examples.zh: 這位作家前往小木屋尋求獨處的時光。

examples.en: There is peace and solitude in the countryside.
examples.zh: 在鄉間可以享受平靜與獨處。

examples.en: The mother sang softly to soothe her crying baby.
examples.zh: 母親輕聲唱歌來安撫哭鬧的寶寶。

examples.en: A warm cup of tea can soothe a sore throat.
examples.zh: 一杯熱茶可以減輕喉嚨痛。

examples.en: Soft music helps soothe my nerves before an exam.
examples.zh: 輕柔的音樂能在考試前舒緩我的緊張情緒。

examples.en: The girl gave a sorrowful look when she lost her pet.
examples.zh: 女孩失去寵物時露出悲傷的神情。

examples.en: They sang a sorrowful song at the funeral.
examples.zh: 他們在葬禮上唱了一首哀傷的歌。

examples.en: His sorrowful voice told us the bad news.
examples.zh: 他憂傷的聲音讓我們知道了壞消息。

examples.en: Japan is a sovereign country located in East Asia.
examples.zh: 日本是位於東亞的主權國家。

examples.en: Every sovereign nation has the right to make its own laws.
examples.zh: 每個主權國家都有權制定自己的法律。

examples.en: The island became a sovereign state after the agreement.
examples.zh: 協議簽訂後，這座島成為了獨立自主的國家。

examples.en: The sovereign gave a speech to the people.
examples.zh: 君主向人民發表談話。

examples.en: The old sovereign ruled the land for fifty years.
examples.zh: 這位老君主統治這片土地五十年。

examples.en: A sovereign usually lives in a large palace.
examples.zh: 君主通常住在一座大宮殿裡。

examples.en: The bridge has a span of two hundred meters.
examples.zh: 這座橋的跨度是兩百公尺。

examples.en: A child's attention span is usually quite short.
examples.zh: 孩子的注意力持續時間通常很短。

examples.en: Over a span of ten years, the town changed a lot.
examples.zh: 在十年的期間裡，這個小鎮改變了很多。

examples.en: A long bridge spans the wide river.
examples.zh: 一座長橋橫跨寬闊的河流。

examples.en: Her career spans more than thirty years.
examples.zh: 她的職涯長達三十多年。

examples.en: The museum's collection spans many centuries, from ancient pottery to modern paintings.
examples.zh: 這間博物館的收藏涵蓋多個世紀，從古代陶器到現代畫作都有。

examples.en: The fireworks made a beautiful spectacle over the harbor.
examples.zh: 煙火在港口上空形成了美麗的壯觀景象。

examples.en: The parade was a colorful spectacle for the children.
examples.zh: 這場遊行對孩子們來說是色彩繽紛的奇觀。

examples.en: He put on his spectacles to read the small print.
examples.zh: 他戴上眼鏡來閱讀小字。

examples.en: A spiral of smoke rose from the chimney.
examples.zh: 一道螺旋狀的煙從煙囪升起。

examples.en: The shell has a beautiful spiral on its surface.
examples.zh: 這個貝殼的表面有漂亮的螺旋紋。

examples.en: Rising prices pushed the family into a spiral of debt.
examples.zh: 物價上漲讓這家人陷入債務的惡性循環。

examples.en: The leaf spiraled slowly down to the ground.
examples.zh: 那片葉子慢慢盤旋落到地上。

examples.en: The kite spiraled up into the sky.
examples.zh: 風箏盤旋著飛上天空。

examples.en: Prices began to spiral out of control last year.
examples.zh: 去年物價開始失控飆升。

examples.en: Tourists admired the splendor of the old palace.
examples.zh: 遊客讚嘆這座古老宮殿的壯麗。

examples.en: The splendor of the sunset made everyone stop and look.
examples.zh: 夕陽的壯麗讓每個人都停下來欣賞。

examples.en: The hotel lobby was decorated with great splendor.
examples.zh: 這間飯店的大廳裝飾得十分華麗。

senses.zh: 自發的；臨時起意的；不做作的

examples.en: The crowd gave the team a spontaneous round of applause.
examples.zh: 群眾自發地為球隊鼓掌。

examples.en: We took a spontaneous trip to the beach last weekend.
examples.zh: 上週末我們臨時起意去了海邊旅行。

examples.en: Her spontaneous laughter made everyone smile during the tense meeting.
examples.zh: 在氣氛緊張的會議中，她自然流露的笑聲讓大家都笑了。

examples.en: The singer stood in the spotlight at the center of the stage.
examples.zh: 歌手站在舞台中央的聚光燈下。

examples.en: The young actor was suddenly in the spotlight after the movie came out.
examples.zh: 電影上映後，這位年輕演員突然成為眾人矚目的焦點。

examples.en: The news put a spotlight on air pollution in the city.
examples.zh: 這則新聞讓這座城市的空氣污染成為關注焦點。

examples.en: The article spotlights several young teachers in the school.
examples.zh: 這篇文章聚焦於學校裡幾位年輕的老師。

examples.en: The festival will spotlight local artists this year.
examples.zh: 今年的藝術節將突顯在地的藝術家。

examples.en: The report spotlighted the need for safer roads.
examples.zh: 這份報告突顯了改善道路安全的必要性。

examples.en: The coach's words spurred the team to play harder.
examples.zh: 教練的話激勵球隊更加努力比賽。

examples.en: Lower prices may spur more people to buy electric cars.
examples.zh: 降低價格也許能促使更多人購買電動車。

examples.en: His success spurred her to work harder.
examples.zh: 他的成功激勵她更努力工作。

examples.en: The prize was a spur for the students to study harder.
examples.zh: 這個獎項成為激勵學生更用功的動力。

examples.en: The cowboy wore a pair of spurs on his boots.
examples.zh: 那位牛仔的靴子上裝了一對馬刺。

examples.en: The new law was a spur to local business.
examples.zh: 這項新法規對本地商業是一種刺激。

examples.en: The doctor gave the patient medicine to stabilize his heartbeat.
examples.zh: 醫生給病人用藥來穩定他的心跳。

examples.en: The government is trying to stabilize the price of rice.
examples.zh: 政府正努力穩定米價。

examples.en: We put a book under the table leg to stabilize it.
examples.zh: 我們在桌腳下墊了一本書讓它穩固。

senses.zh: 搖搖晃晃地走；錯開；使震驚

examples.en: The tired runner staggered across the finish line.
examples.zh: 疲憊的跑者搖搖晃晃地跨過終點線。

examples.en: The company will stagger working hours to avoid traffic jams.
examples.zh: 公司會讓上班時間錯開以避免塞車。

examples.en: The unexpected cost of repairing the roof staggered the homeowner.
examples.zh: 修屋頂的意外費用讓屋主大吃一驚。

examples.en: Rice is the staple of many Asian countries.
examples.zh: 米飯是許多亞洲國家的主食。

examples.en: Please put a staple in the top corner of the report.
examples.zh: 請在報告上方的一角釘上一根釘書針。

examples.en: Milk and eggs are staples in our kitchen.
examples.zh: 牛奶和雞蛋是我們廚房裡的必備品。

examples.en: Bread is the staple food in many countries.
examples.zh: 麵包是許多國家的主食。

examples.en: Rice is a staple crop in this region.
examples.zh: 稻米是這個地區的主要作物。

examples.en: Noodles are a staple part of the local diet.
examples.zh: 麵食是當地飲食的主要部分。

examples.en: Please staple the pages together before you hand them in.
examples.zh: 交出去之前，請把這幾頁釘在一起。

examples.en: She stapled the receipt to the form.
examples.zh: 她把收據釘在表格上。

examples.en: I need to staple these documents for the meeting.
examples.zh: 我得把這些文件釘好給會議使用。

examples.en: The old statesman was respected by people from all parties.
examples.zh: 這位老政治家受到各黨派人士的尊敬。

examples.en: The statesman gave a speech about peace at the conference.
examples.zh: 這位政治家在會議上發表了關於和平的演說。

examples.en: Many students read about the great statesman in history class.
examples.zh: 許多學生在歷史課上讀到這位偉大的政治家。

examples.en: The car was stationary at the red light.
examples.zh: 那輛車在紅燈前靜止不動。

examples.en: Please stay seated until the train is stationary.
examples.zh: 請在火車完全靜止前坐在座位上。

examples.en: A stationary bike is a good way to exercise at home.
examples.zh: 固定式健身車是在家運動的好方法。

examples.en: The boy is small in stature but very good at basketball.
examples.zh: 這個男孩身材矮小，但很會打籃球。

examples.en: The scientist is a person of great stature in the field.
examples.zh: 這位科學家在該領域享有崇高的聲望。

examples.en: His kindness raised his stature among the neighbors.
examples.zh: 他的善良提高了他在鄰居間的地位。

examples.en: He treats his stepchild as warmly as his own son.
examples.zh: 他對待配偶的孩子，就像對待自己的兒子一樣親切。

examples.en: The stepchild called her new father by his first name.
examples.zh: 那個繼女直呼她新爸爸的名字。

examples.en: A stepchild may need time to feel at home in a new family.
examples.zh: 繼子女可能需要時間才能在新家庭中感到自在。

examples.en: Babies need stimulation from toys and music to learn.
examples.zh: 嬰兒需要玩具和音樂的刺激來學習。

examples.en: Reading gives the brain good mental stimulation.
examples.zh: 閱讀能給大腦良好的心智刺激。

examples.en: Some children get little stimulation at home.
examples.zh: 有些孩子在家裡得到的刺激很少。

examples.en: Ships pass through the narrow strait every day.
examples.zh: 每天都有船隻穿過這條狹窄的海峽。

examples.en: The Taiwan Strait lies between Taiwan and mainland China.
examples.zh: 台灣海峽位於台灣與中國大陸之間。

examples.en: Many families were in financial straits after the local factory closed.
examples.zh: 當地工廠關閉後，許多家庭陷入財務困境。

examples.en: The weeds began to strangle the young plants in the garden.
examples.zh: 雜草開始嚴重阻礙花園裡幼苗的生長。

examples.en: This tight collar feels as if it might strangle me.
examples.zh: 這個緊繃的衣領讓我覺得快喘不過氣來。

examples.en: Too many rules can strangle new ideas.
examples.zh: 過多的規定可能扼殺新的想法。

examples.en: A stray dog followed us all the way home.
examples.zh: 一隻流浪狗一路跟著我們回家。

examples.en: We gave the stray cat some food and water.
examples.zh: 我們給了那隻流浪貓一些食物和水。

examples.en: A stray ball flew into our yard.
examples.zh: 一顆偏離目標的球飛進了我們的院子。

examples.en: Don't let the children stray too far from the camp.
examples.zh: 別讓孩子們離營地太遠。

examples.en: The speaker strayed from the topic during the talk.
examples.zh: 講者在演講中偏離了主題。

examples.en: My little brother strayed away from us in the market.
examples.zh: 我弟弟在市場裡走失了。

examples.en: He crossed the room in three long strides.
examples.zh: 他三大步就走過了房間。

examples.en: She kept her stride steady during the marathon.
examples.zh: 她在馬拉松中保持穩定的步伐。

examples.en: The school has made great strides in teaching English.
examples.zh: 這所學校在英語教學上有了很大的進步。

examples.en: The teacher strode into the classroom with a smile.
examples.zh: 老師面帶微笑大步走進教室。

examples.en: He strode up to the counter and asked for a ticket.
examples.zh: 他大步走到櫃檯要了一張票。

examples.en: The manager strode across the lobby to meet us.
examples.zh: 經理大步穿過大廳來迎接我們。

examples.en: We like to stroll along the beach after dinner.
examples.zh: 我們喜歡晚餐後沿著海灘散步。

examples.en: Tourists strolled through the old street with their cameras.
examples.zh: 遊客們帶著相機在老街上閒逛。

examples.en: She strolled around the park while waiting for her friend.
examples.zh: 她等朋友時在公園裡閒逛。

examples.en: Grandpa takes a stroll in the park every morning.
examples.zh: 爺爺每天早上都會在公園裡散步。

examples.en: The hotel is a short stroll from the night market.
examples.zh: 這間飯店離夜市只有一小段散步的路程。

examples.en: We went for a stroll by the lake.
examples.zh: 我們去湖邊散了個步。

examples.en: The sudden news stunned the whole class.
examples.zh: 這個突如其來的消息讓全班震驚。

examples.en: Her beautiful voice stunned the judges at the school singing contest.
examples.zh: 她美妙的歌聲在學校歌唱比賽中讓評審們驚豔不已。

examples.en: The loud noise nearly stunned the little bird.
examples.zh: 那巨大的聲響差點讓那隻小鳥昏過去。

examples.en: He stuttered when he was nervous in front of the class.
examples.zh: 他在全班面前緊張時會結巴。

examples.en: She stuttered a few words and then stopped.
examples.zh: 她結結巴巴地說了幾個字就停下來了。

examples.en: The boy stuttered an apology to his teacher.
examples.zh: 男孩結結巴巴地向老師道歉。

examples.en: He has had a stutter since he was a child.
examples.zh: 他從小就有口吃。

examples.en: The actor worked hard to overcome his stutter.
examples.zh: 這位演員努力克服他的口吃。

examples.en: You could hear a slight stutter in her voice.
examples.zh: 你可以聽出她的聲音有些結巴。

examples.en: She wore a stylish coat to the party.
examples.zh: 她穿著一件時髦的外套去參加派對。

examples.en: This café has a stylish design with wooden tables.
examples.zh: 這間咖啡店設計時尚，配有木桌。

examples.en: My uncle drives a stylish little car.
examples.zh: 我叔叔開著一輛有型的小車。

examples.en: Taste in music is subjective, so friends may prefer different styles.
examples.zh: 音樂品味是主觀的，所以朋友之間可能偏好不同風格。

examples.en: The teacher asked us to avoid subjective opinions in the report.
examples.zh: 老師要求我們在報告中避免主觀的意見。

examples.en: Beauty is a subjective idea that differs from person to person.
examples.zh: 美是一種因人而異的主觀想法。

examples.en: Safety should never be subordinate to speed.
examples.zh: 安全絕不該屈居於速度之後。

examples.en: He holds a subordinate position in the company.
examples.zh: 他在公司裡擔任下級職務。

examples.en: The report was written by a subordinate officer.
examples.zh: 這份報告是由一位下級官員撰寫的。

examples.en: A good manager listens to her subordinates.
examples.zh: 好的主管會傾聽部屬的意見。

examples.en: He treats his subordinates with respect, even when they make mistakes.
examples.zh: 即使自己的部屬犯錯，他也會尊重他們。

examples.en: The boss thanked his subordinates for their hard work.
examples.zh: 老闆感謝部屬們的辛勤工作。

examples.en: I subscribe to a weekly English magazine.
examples.zh: 我訂閱了一份英文週刊。

examples.en: Please subscribe to our channel for more videos.
examples.zh: 請訂閱我們的頻道以觀看更多影片。

examples.en: I do not subscribe to the view that money guarantees happiness.
examples.zh: 我不贊同金錢能保證幸福的看法。

examples.en: My monthly subscription to the online magazine costs ten dollars.
examples.zh: 我的線上雜誌訂閱費每月是十美元。

examples.en: You can cancel your subscription at any time.
examples.zh: 你可以隨時取消訂閱。

examples.en: A one-year subscription includes twelve issues of the magazine.
examples.zh: 一年的訂閱包含十二期雜誌。

examples.en: The government subsidizes lunches for students in need.
examples.zh: 政府補助有需要的學生的午餐。

examples.en: The city subsidizes public transportation for senior citizens.
examples.zh: 這座城市補助長者搭乘大眾運輸。

examples.en: The company subsidized part of the employees' English classes.
examples.zh: 公司補助員工部分英語課程費用。

examples.en: We had a succession of rainy days last week.
examples.zh: 上週我們這裡連續下了好幾天雨。

examples.en: The prince is next in succession to the throne.
examples.zh: 王子是王位的下一位繼承人。

examples.en: The company planned the succession of its new manager carefully.
examples.zh: 公司仔細規劃新經理的接班事宜。

examples.en: The team won three successive games this month.
examples.zh: 這支球隊這個月連贏三場比賽。

examples.en: It rained for four successive days, forcing us to cancel the camping trip.
examples.zh: 連續下了四天雨，迫使我們取消露營行程。

examples.en: She won the speech contest for the second successive year.
examples.zh: 她連續第二年贏得演講比賽。

examples.en: The thick smoke nearly suffocated the people in the room.
examples.zh: 濃煙差點讓房間裡的人窒息。

examples.en: I felt like I was suffocating in the crowded elevator.
examples.zh: 在擁擠的電梯裡，我覺得快要喘不過氣。

examples.en: Keep plastic bags away from babies so they cannot suffocate.
examples.zh: 請讓塑膠袋遠離嬰兒，以免他們窒息。

examples.en: The principal summoned the students to his office.
examples.zh: 校長把學生召喚到他的辦公室。

examples.en: The manager summoned all the staff to an emergency meeting.
examples.zh: 經理召集所有員工參加緊急會議。

examples.en: She summoned her courage and spoke in front of the class.
examples.zh: 她鼓起勇氣在全班面前發言。

examples.en: The cut on his finger was only superficial.
examples.zh: 他手指上的傷口只是皮肉傷。

examples.en: She has only a superficial knowledge of the subject.
examples.zh: 她對這個主題只有膚淺的認識。

examples.en: The two brothers look alike but have only superficial similarities.
examples.zh: 這對兄弟長得像，但只有表面上的相似。

examples.en: The school superintendent visited our class yesterday.
examples.zh: 學區總監昨天來參訪我們班。

examples.en: The building superintendent fixed the broken light in the hall.
examples.zh: 大樓管理員修好了走廊壞掉的燈。

examples.en: The superintendent announced a new plan for the school district.
examples.zh: 這位總監宣布了一項學區的新計畫。

examples.en: The team showed its superiority by winning every game.
examples.zh: 這支球隊靠贏下每一場比賽展現了優勢。

examples.en: He spoke with an air of superiority that annoyed his classmates.
examples.zh: 他說話帶著優越感，讓同學們很不舒服。

examples.en: The superiority of this phone lies in its battery life.
examples.zh: 這支手機的優勢在於電池續航力。

examples.en: My grandmother is superstitious about the number four.
examples.zh: 我奶奶對數字四很迷信。

examples.en: Some superstitious people think black cats bring bad luck.
examples.zh: 有些迷信的人認為黑貓會帶來厄運。

examples.en: The player is superstitious and always wears the same socks.
examples.zh: 這位球員很迷信，總是穿同一雙襪子。

examples.en: She takes a vitamin supplement every morning.
examples.zh: 她每天早上都吃維他命補充劑。

examples.en: The newspaper comes with a weekend supplement.
examples.zh: 這份報紙附有週末增刊。

examples.en: The teacher gave us a supplement to the textbook.
examples.zh: 老師給了我們一份課本的補充教材。

examples.en: He works part-time to supplement his income.
examples.zh: 他兼差來補貼收入。

examples.en: You can supplement your diet with more fruit.
examples.zh: 你可以在飲食中增加水果。

examples.en: Students may supplement the lesson with online videos.
examples.zh: 學生可以用線上影片來補充課程。

examples.en: The company tried to suppress evidence of problems with its products.
examples.zh: 這家公司試圖隱瞞產品有問題的證據。

examples.en: He tried to suppress a laugh during the speech.
examples.zh: 他在演講時試圖忍住不笑出來。

examples.en: This medicine can suppress a cough for several hours.
examples.zh: 這種藥可以抑制咳嗽好幾個小時。

senses.zh: 激增；情緒湧現；電力突波

examples.en: There was a surge in online shopping during the holidays.
examples.zh: 假期期間網路購物量激增。

examples.en: She felt a surge of joy when she heard the good news.
examples.zh: 聽到好消息時，她心中湧起一陣喜悅。

examples.en: A power surge damaged the old computer.
examples.zh: 電流突波損壞了那台舊電腦。

examples.en: The crowd surged toward the stage when the singer appeared.
examples.zh: 歌手出現時，群眾湧向舞台。

examples.en: Food prices surged after the storm damaged roads and delayed deliveries.
examples.zh: 暴風雨損壞道路、延誤運送後，食品價格飆漲。

examples.en: Water surged into the street after the heavy rain.
examples.zh: 大雨過後，水湧上了街道。

examples.en: The nurse handed the doctor a surgical tool.
examples.zh: 護理師遞給醫生一把手術器械。

examples.en: All surgical masks must be thrown away after use.
examples.zh: 所有外科口罩使用後都必須丟棄。

examples.en: He needs a surgical operation on his knee.
examples.zh: 他的膝蓋需要動手術。

examples.en: Her test score surpassed everyone's expectations after months of steady practice.
examples.zh: 經過數月持續練習後，她的考試成績超出了所有人的預期。

examples.en: The new phone surpasses the old one in speed.
examples.zh: 這支新手機的速度勝過舊的那支。

examples.en: Sales this year have surpassed last year's record.
examples.zh: 今年的銷售量已經超越去年的紀錄。

examples.en: The movie is full of suspense from beginning to end.
examples.zh: 這部電影從頭到尾都充滿懸疑。

examples.en: Don't keep us in suspense; tell us the result.
examples.zh: 別讓我們懸著心，快告訴我們結果。

examples.en: The suspense grew as the judges opened the envelope.
examples.zh: 評審打開信封時，緊張的氣氛越來越濃。

examples.en: Frogs and snakes live in the swamp near our village.
examples.zh: 青蛙和蛇住在我們村子附近的沼澤裡。

examples.en: The farmer turned the swamp into a rice field.
examples.zh: 農夫把沼澤變成了稻田。

examples.en: It is hard to walk through the swamp after rain.
examples.zh: 下雨後很難走過那片沼澤。

examples.en: The heavy rain swamped the small boat.
examples.zh: 大雨使那艘小船被水淹沒。

examples.en: The store was swamped with customers on sale day.
examples.zh: 特價那天，店裡擠滿了顧客，忙得不可開交。

examples.en: I am swamped with homework this week.
examples.zh: 這週我被功課壓得喘不過氣。
